name: Modern Bookshop
tagline: A bright, working storefront for a modern bookshop.
description: A complete, working shop for a bright, contemporary bookshop: a real catalogue of new releases, fiction, nonfiction and books for young readers, plus an enamel-pin set, a clip reading light and a monthly reading subscription — with categories, collections, a bespoke cover-forward PDP and a full merchandised home page led by new releases. Crisp modern theme — a near-white ground, a confident blue, a coral accent, a clean grotesk display. Shipped as Volume Books.
